A health day is also part of the event, with mental health professionals and therapy demonstrations for participants. Free parking is available at the Vasi Skanzen car park.

The start and finish are at the UFM Arena, which has changing rooms, showers, and a bag drop. Chip timing is provided, and a time limit applies to the longest distance. The 209-kilometer distance is open to individual entrants and teams of 2–6 people. The event has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and offers appealing activities for supporters and cyclists as well as runners.

The race starts at the Kolonics György Recreation Center on Csepel’s beautiful Danube waterfront and offers four distances: 3.5 km, 7 km, a 400 m children’s race, and a special race for people with disabilities. The event aims to share the joy of community and physical activity with people of all ages, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Race bibs are mandatory for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.

The start is at 10:00, and registration is open until 18:00 on April 23.

name: BACKYARD ULTRA ESZTERGOM

Competitors complete a 6,706-meter loop every hour, and only those who finish before the next start remain in the race. The event is part of the Hungarian Backyard League and is held as an age-group championship, with the top female and male runners awarded prizes in 11 age groups. The race takes place at Franka Pálya - Gimnázium Sportpálya in Esztergom, and participants who complete distances of up to 160 kilometers may also receive recognition.

The event offers several distances, from 500 meters up to the half marathon (21 km). The race starts in front of the City Sports Hall and follows the Szebeni út, Petőfi út, and Gerincút route before returning to the sports hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom, and toilets are available for runners at the venue. The event aims to promote sport and community for all age groups.

Participants can choose from a 500-meter family run, as well as 2, 5, and 10-kilometer and half-marathon distances. Runners can complete the courses across varied terrain in a natural setting, including the 10 km and half-marathon routes. The event aims to promote a love of sport and nature in a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB

With a new start location, the race begins in Bozsok and offers runners several distances, from an introductory 7 km trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses traverse varied terrain, with beautiful panoramas and aid stations. Participants will need endurance and good physical fitness. The race also offers family-friendly activities, so even the youngest visitors can enjoy the nature conservation and interactive exhibitions.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS

Runners can test their strength on varied routes close to nature, enjoying its beauty and the challenging terrain. The race is organized by Futapest Klub, which has supported trail running and cross-country running in Hungary for many years. All runners are warmly welcome to join this friendly, community-oriented running event.

The local wine region and the sense of community give the race its unique atmosphere.

description: The Kecskemét Sports Festival is a traditional community sporting event in Kecskemét, around Benkó Hill. The event aims to promote recreational exercise and sport, welcoming participants in a family-friendly atmosphere with a variety of running events. Alongside running, the festival also features charity events and community activities, bringing sport and social responsibility together. The organizers warmly welcome everyone who wants to run and enjoy the pleasure of exercise and being close to nature.

name: UTBT (Ultra Tokaj-Bodrogkeresztúr-Tarcal)
description: The Ultra Tokaj - Bodrogkeresztúr - Tarcal running race is a challenging 63 km ultra-distance event that winds through the scenic vineyards and hills of Tokaj-Hegyalja. The race offers three different distances, so beginners and experienced runners alike can find the ideal challenge for them. The event is more than just a running race—it is an experience set amid the landscapes of one of Hungary’s most beautiful wine regions. All races start with a mass start, and runners receive refreshments along the course and at the finish.

name: BRUTÁLFUTÁS
description: Brutálfutás is a fun obstacle race in Nyáregyháza, offering an unforgettable muddy, splash-filled experience over 2.3- and 7-kilometer distances. The race combines a military training course with an obstacle race, with fun and community at its heart. Participants can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and plenty of mud, and come from hundreds of towns and villages across the country. This race isn’t about taking things seriously—it’s about fun and a challenge, so everyone can find a distance that suits them.

name: X. Sopron Trail 5 / 10 / 25

description: The Sopron Trail 2026 trail running race will take place on June 14, 2026, in the scenic surroundings of Sopron-Brennbergbánya. The race aims to promote trail running and showcase the wild landscapes of the Sopron Hills. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5.9 km, 10.7 km, and 25.9 km. One of the distances is part of the Alpokalja Terepkirály running series. The race also offers a special extra challenge on a timed uphill section, where the fastest male and female runners will receive special prizes. The race center is at the Brennbergbánya Cultural Center, where toilets and showers are available.

name: CROSSKOVÁCSI Dockyard Terepfutó verseny
description: The Crosskovácsi Dockyard Trail Running Race is a trail-running event offering a variety of distances in the scenic surroundings of Nagykovácsi, near Teleki-Tisza Castle. The race has four distances: mini (3 km), short (7 km), middle distance (13.5 km), and mountain half marathon (21.7 km). Each begins with a 1 km opening loop in the castle park. The courses cross varied terrain with significant elevation gain, and refreshments are available at aid stations. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. The race uses electronic timing, and the organizers pay particular attention to runner safety and medical care.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 1st Midsummer Night Running Fire is a night running festival in Balatonszárszó, at Tóparti Park, held on Midsummer’s Eve. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the shore of Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes families and community sports enthusiasts as well as runners. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers the opportunity to collect points for valuable rewards.

The race is held in honor of Saint Ladislaus, the patron saint of the infantry and artillery branches. It has been held regularly since 2010, with just one cancellation, in 2013, due to flooding. Runners can test their strength on varied terrain, including forest trails and rolling hills. This friendly community event is recommended for anyone interested in outdoor activities and sport.

The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide accessible sporting opportunities for all ages, whether running, walking or cycling. The event hub is the historic Jankovich Mansion, an ideal venue for the start and finish as well as the accompanying activities. Participants can look forward to unique medals and T-shirts, and the event offers a friendly atmosphere close to nature.

The race consists of 18 stages that run through the Štiavnica Mountains and the Danube-Ipoly National Park, offering a wealth of natural and cultural attractions. Runners can compete in teams of various sizes or in individual categories, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The race aims to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region’s natural and historical heritage.

Participants can look forward to unique finisher medals, refreshment stations and a hot meal, while the organisers strive to make the event environmentally friendly.

Runners are required to use a headlamp or another light source, as some sections of the course are unlit. The event is organized by the Esztergom Futóművek Amateur Sports Association and also serves as a points-collecting stop in the Ötpróba program.

description: The 9th Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running race in Szeged, welcoming runners for a night half-marathon. The event also serves as a family-friendly sports day where participants can enjoy exercising together. It takes place on Népkert sor, an ideal setting for both running and family activities. The event is traditionally very popular, attracting more than 1,100 participants.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The event combines the excitement of relay running with the beauty of nature, as participants test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. It has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers an enjoyable program for spectators as well as runners. Open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike, the race is an important event in local sporting life.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The VII. Stars Along the Way… Night Run is a unique running experience at Platán Beach in Balatonboglár, where runners and walkers are welcomed on July 11 in a summery lakeside setting. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor, a paved surface throughout, and full street lighting along the route. Participants can choose between 3.5, 7, and 10.5-kilometer distances, and walking and a 500-meter children’s distance are also available. The event warmly welcomes all ages and fitness levels to experience the magic of running at night together.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer race between Barcs and Heresznye, being held for the fifth time. Runners from several counties take part, with men and women competing in separate categories. The course is varied, and record times have been set in previous years, reflecting the race’s competitive nature and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye Municipality, creating a friendly and competitive atmosphere for participants.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake running race is a traditional event with a friendly, family atmosphere, held near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, around the scenic Köcsi Lake. Everyone who wants to run or walk is warmly welcome to enjoy the natural surroundings and the community sporting experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which is dedicated to sport and environmental protection. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
description: The Lázbérc Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationally organized running event in Hungary, held in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and provides participants with a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in a picturesque setting. The event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcome.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, nonprofit running race taking place in Dunabogdány on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. The race offers challenges over two distances: 6.1 km with 205 m of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 m of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique metal finisher’s medal, and the top finishers are awarded prizes by age group and overall. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and registration allows for on-site changes. Places are limited to a maximum of 200 participants.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: The Gaja Valley Trail is a trail-running event organized by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on July 25, 2026, in Fehérvárcsurgó, near Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances. The focus is not on competition, but on the joy of exercise, the shared experience, and being close to nature. The event aims to promote running at every level, from beginners to experienced runners, in a pleasant summer woodland setting. The start and finish are at the Károlyi Castle Visitor Center, while the babbling Gaja Stream and the quiet of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.

Runners can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes in Makkos Park. A special feature of the event is a live-music aid station, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes runners twice. The event aims to promote the joy of sport and exercise, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: Csernye Trail is a trail running race taking place for the sixth time in 2026 in Bakonycsernye. Starting from the start area next to the sports field, runners can choose from various distances that lead across varied terrain, through forests and over hills. The organizers promise excellent event management and an enjoyable running experience, while participants can admire the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
description: The Orfű Lake-Show Run is the traditional running race of the Melitta Leisure Sports Association, held around the large car park by Lake Orfű and its beach. During the race, participants must run one or two laps around Lake Pécs on the road, clockwise, not along the promenade. The race is a family-friendly event, and everyone participates at their own risk. Both professionals and amateurs are welcome. The event is held with the support of Barta Textilház and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on their finishing times.

The race takes place in the Keresztúri Forest near Budapest and offers challenges over several distances, including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, the half marathon, 31.6 km and the marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. The event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has supported running enthusiasts since 1977. The race aims to give every participant the chance to experience camaraderie through sport and the joy of surpassing themselves.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run takes place in Kecskemét at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre, offering a running experience as a sporty complement to the jazz festival. The event traditionally puts the joy of running and the sense of community first, and is open to all ages and types of runners. It is not only a sporting event but also strengthens local community ties, while participants can enjoy exercising in beautiful surroundings and fresh air. The organizers also consider charity important, so the run is an opportunity to support a cause.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized by the Enthusiastic Team of Szigethalom Ultrarunners on the second weekend of every August. The 20th anniversary festival in 2026 will take place in Tököl Park Forest and feature a variety of distances, including an ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter races, and hiking. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with plenty of activities for children as well as runners. Its goal is to promote sport and support the local community, with a particular focus on helping people with disabilities.

The event is a trail run on a varied and challenging course that combines the experience of being close to nature with the enjoyment of sport. It has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all age groups, and fosters a sense of community among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth event operations and participant satisfaction.

name: KESZTHELYI KILOMÉTEREK
description: Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, taking place on August 22–23, 2026, in the rear park of Festetics Palace. Participants can choose from several distances, ranging from 3 km to the half marathon, in individual or relay categories. Children’s races are also held for the youngest runners, with different distances for each age group. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and the lakeside setting offers runners a special experience.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race in Szombathely’s main square, offering both children and amateur runners the opportunity to take part. The sunset and the atmosphere of the city center give the race its special feel, creating an enjoyable and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all age groups while also providing a shared community experience.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
description: The Budai Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night on the scenic forest trails of the Buda Hills. Participants run with headlamps, enjoying a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two challenging distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere, and the start is at the Sports Hall in Telki.

name: SUHANJ!6
description: SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and helps fund the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible in 6 hours on a flat, accessible 3.5 km loop. The race starts at midnight, and a sunrise is guaranteed. You can enter as an individual or as part of a team of 2–10 people, with unlimited relay changes allowed. The Éj Félmaraton also starts at midnight and follows the SUHANJ! 6 course; it is limited to 200 participants.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP

The entry fee is voluntary, at 500 Ft per loop, to help cover the costs of the race. All participants can enjoy an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female finishers each receive a unique medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.

The event offers a range of distances, including 14 km, 22.5 km, and 42 km runs, as well as a mountain-bike race. The course is close to nature and follows agricultural dirt roads, with aid stations every 4–5 kilometers. The event aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local community together. Participants must protect nature and follow the rules, and mountain bikers are required to wear helmets.

The event offers challenges over several distances, including 10.5 km and 21 km races that pass through the city's landmarks. The race uses unique chip timing, and places are ranked by gun time. With age restrictions and a limited number of participants, the event welcomes runners in a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: EMU 6 DAYS RACE / GOMU 6 DAYS WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP
description: The EMU 6-Day Race, also known as the GOMU 6-Day World Championship, is one of the world’s most prestigious multi-day ultramarathon events, held in Balatonfüred. During the race, participants run for six days, testing their stamina and endurance. The event is traditionally the pinnacle of multi-day ultrarunning, and world records have been set there. Competitors face a unique challenge that tests both their physical and mental strength.

name: SÜMEG TRAIL
description: The Sümeg Trail is a major sporting event in the town of Sümeg and has attracted running enthusiasts for five years. The race offers challenges over four distances, which participants can complete amid the town’s distinctive and beautiful surroundings. The event also includes a range of sports activities and health screenings, with yoga classes, meditation and other forms of exercise on offer alongside the running. The Sümeg Trail is a lively community event that promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle.

name: XI. Moonlight Run
description: The XI Moonlight Run is an atmospheric running race in the town of Szob, taking place on September 12, 2026. Participants receive timing, a race bib, and a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, where runners can enjoy traditional lard bread with onions. The event takes place under medical supervision, and the organizers prioritize the experience of taking part.

name: ATOMFUTÁS

The event offers runners several distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. Traditionally, the race offers significant early-bird discounts to entrants and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. The event aims to strengthen sport and community, while participants enjoy varied courses and the beauty of the Paks surroundings.

name: MOONLIGHT RUN
description: MOONLIGHT RUN is a special night race in the town of Szob, taking place on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at the Church of Saint Ladislaus, and participants receive a unique finisher’s medal. Refreshments and medical supervision are provided during the event, and traditional lard bread with onions awaits runners at the finish. The race is organized by Proathlon Bt. with the support of the local governments.

name: 36. BorsodChem Bódva-völgyi Maraton
description: The 36th BorsodChem Bódva Valley Marathon is a traditional running race held near Edelény. It offers runners a range of distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge. The event has a friendly, family atmosphere, and participants are provided with professional RFID chip timing. Runners can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bódva Valley and its varied terrain.

The race offers runners several distances, including options for children and adults, at different difficulty levels. The event traditionally takes place in mid-September and offers participants a unique experience thanks to its venue and organization. The race’s honorary patron is Olympic champion Dr. Antal Kovács, further enhancing its prestige.

The race pack includes a premium Mizuno T-shirt, a custom-designed finisher’s medal awaits at the finish, and eco-friendly, cup-free refreshments are provided. The route runs mostly along the waterfront, allowing participants to enjoy the atmosphere of Lake Balaton and the early autumn sunshine.

name: ESZTERGOM FÉLMARATON
description: The Esztergom Half Marathon is a running event with a variety of distances, held in Esztergom’s historic districts, including Castle Hill and the Water Town, as well as on the riverside cycle path. Individual and relay runners can choose from several distances, and shorter races are organized separately for children. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also serves as a points-collection station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to collect points and earn rewards. The event’s honorary patrons include the Mayor of Esztergom and well-known athletes, adding to its prestige.

name: Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026
description: The Wink-Intretech KapuvárRun 2026 will be held for the fifth time in Kapuvár, in Eszterházi Park. The race takes place on completely flat city streets and attracts more Hungarian and international runners each year. The event aims to share the joy of movement and the sense of community, with a great atmosphere and togetherness at its heart. The experience continues after the finish, with award ceremonies and a large event tent where spectators can comfortably cheer on the runners.

name: BERLIN MARATON
description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s largest and most popular marathons, taking place in Berlin on September 27, 2026. The race is famous for its record-breaking, exceptionally flat course, which passes many of the city’s most beautiful landmarks. The event offers a special experience not only for professional runners but also for running enthusiasts, thanks to its diversity and the city’s unique energy. The race is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors series, and participants can choose from a range of events, including the charity run, inline skating, and the Generali 5K.

It offers distances for several age groups, from kindergarten children to adults, on paved roads and short dirt sections. The quarter marathon features chip timing, refreshment stations and medals. All distances are free to enter. The event aims to promote community sports and running, in memory of István Maróti.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running event held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a range of distances for runners from beginners to advanced athletes. The race is distinguished by the beautiful panoramic views of the Balaton Uplands and its challenging, varied terrain, which takes in the peninsula’s most scenic areas. Many runners choose the half-marathon distance for their first half marathon, as the course and its spectacular sections make for an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a baby run for the youngest participants. Runners in every distance receive a finisher’s medal, refreshments, and a running shirt.

description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a two-day running event taking place in Budapest on October 10–11, 2026. During the race, participants can run past Budapest’s most beautiful World Heritage sites while enjoying the city’s panoramas and lively crowd support. The festival celebrates running, with a distance for everyone, from 5 km to the marathon. Participants receive a unique finisher’s medal and running shirt, while a range of accompanying activities and musical experiences make the weekend unforgettable.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: The 41st SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a running event held over a full weekend, taking place in Budapest on October 11. Participants can enter races ranging from 5 to 42.195 km, so everyone can find the right challenge for them. The event aims to provide runners with an unforgettable experience, from beginners to experienced marathoners. With the support of its chief patrons and patrons, the marathon is a true bucket-list challenge that takes runners through Budapest’s iconic locations.

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: Panoráma Trail is a 45-kilometer trail running race in the Zemplén Mountains, linking the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The race is not about finishing times, but about the experience and being close to nature, as runners make their way along rocky trails, cross streams, and run through woodland. You can enter individually or as part of a 3-person team, making it possible to take on the challenge together. The event offers a premium experience in every detail, from the race pack to the finisher’s medal presented at the finish.

The race crosses varied terrain, steep climbs and forest trails, offering runners an unforgettable experience surrounded by nature and panoramic views. A special feature of the race is the ultra distance, which can be completed as a team and puts shared experiences and perseverance at the forefront.

description: The II. South Balaton Csillagó Trail is a scenic running race taking place on October 18, 2026, in Kötcse, near the Gutman Wine Cellar. The race follows panoramic routes through the hills of Somogy, around Csillagó Hill, with a variety of distances, including a half marathon and a two-person relay. Participants can run among beautiful autumn vineyards, forests, and historic sites, with a unique finisher’s medal and gifts awaiting them at the finish. The Csillagó Trail festival wine glass also adds to the atmosphere, giving runners a chance to sample local wines as well as enjoy the race.

name: Veresegyház Futónap
description: The Veresegyház Running Day is a family-friendly running event held near Búcsú Square in Veresegyház. Participants can choose from several distances, from the mini race to the half marathon, and can compete individually or as part of a team. The race is also a points-collection stop in the Ötpróba program, so participants can earn points and rewards. Team running is a separate category in which teams of three compete, but each team member must complete the distance individually. The event is a friendly community gathering that promotes the joy of running and an active lifestyle.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail-running race that winds through the wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hidden in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the grueling climb up Szádvár, panoramic views from Esztramos Hill, and the atmospheric wine-cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This challenging race welcomes adventure-seekers to Szögliget in October.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race takes place in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps. Those who would prefer to run fewer laps may do so. The race has a voluntary entry fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place at the venue. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.

Runners can test their abilities over various distances in a friendly and supportive environment. The program includes a carnival atmosphere and the joy of exercising together.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: Halloween Run 2026 is a special, exciting running event in Budapest, held on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery. During the race, participants run along a dark, spooky course accompanied by frightening characters and eerie effects. Races are held over various distances, from short tours to longer multi-lap events, so everyone can find a suitable option. At the finish, music and celebrations await the brave participants who have overcome the challenges.
course_highlights: Course on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery
Dark, spooky visuals and frightening effects
A variety of distances, including a 21 km lap race and running through a tunnel
additional: The event takes place at Rottenbiller Park in Budapest's 10th district. It is easily accessible by public transport, but parking is limited. The program includes several races, from 2.5 km Halloween tours to a 21 km individual and relay race. On-site registration is available up to 45 minutes before the race start, provided online registration has not filled up. The awards ceremony begins at 15:40. name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: The Vaskapu Trail is a nature-focused trail-running race in Esztergom, offering runners a challenge over three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km. The course follows trails and marked hiking paths, with minimal road sections, allowing participants to enjoy the natural scenery and varied terrain. The event is environmentally conscious, with cup-free aid stations and support for the Green Forest program. The start and finish are at the Vaskapu Restaurant, at the Brilli Gyula shelter, where participants can also use changing rooms and bag storage.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths and marked hiking routes
Three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km, with varied levels of difficulty
Minimal road sections for a nature-focused experience
additional: The race uses chip timing; chips are issued against a 2,000 HUF deposit. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring a hydration vest or their own cup. Race-pack collection takes place at the race center on race day; earlier collection is not available. Entries may be cancelled until 2026.10.15; after that, they can only be transferred to the following year. The race center has separate women’s and men’s changing rooms and a built-in toilet, but no washbasin. All finishers receive a finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men overall receive separate awards. Participants must bring the equipment needed for hydration. Changing rooms and bag storage are available on site, and environmentally friendly solutions are used to support participants.

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race among the hills of Dunaföldvár, with stunning views and an impressive race headquarters at Ispánház. Runners can choose from several distances, from children’s races to the 23 km course, with women’s and men’s categories awarded separately. The courses run mostly on dirt roads, with minimal paved sections, allowing participants to enjoy being close to nature. The event is run as a green event, so the organisers ask runners to bring a reusable bottle or their own cup to the refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Trail routes among the hills of Dunaföldvár
Stunning views of the southern Danube Bend from Kálvária and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads, with minimal paved sections
